name: Turnery
description: Parametric CAD by chat: feature tree, kernel-checked sizes, STEP/STL export. Needs Turnery on Mac.
description_zh: 用对话建参数化 CAD 零件：特征树随时可改，尺寸由几何内核复核，导出 STEP/STL。需要先在 Mac 上安装 Turnery。
description_en: Parametric CAD by chat: feature tree, kernel-checked sizes, STEP/STL export. Needs Turnery on Mac.
examples_zh: 用 Turnery 建一个 60×40×25 mm 的盒子，壁厚 2 mm，四角打 M3 螺丝孔
给树莓派 Pico 做一个不用支撑就能 3D 打印的外壳
把刚才那个支架的壁厚改成 3 mm，导出 STL
examples_en: Use Turnery to build a 60×40×25 mm box with 2 mm walls and M3 holes in the corners
Make an enclosure for a Raspberry Pi Pico that prints without supports
Change the bracket's wall to 3 mm and export an STL
